title: Continuous Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation Using PPG From Methods to Clinical Translation
abstract: arXiv:2611.17499v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous blood pressure (BP) monitoring could improve hypertension management by capturing changes that intermittent cuff measurements miss. Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely explored for cuffless BP estimation because optical sensors are inexpensive, wearable, and already present in many consumer and clinical devices. PPG, however, does not measure arterial pressure: BP is inferred from waveform characteristics or pulse timing, which also depend on vascular tone, arterial stiffness, sensor contact, motion, and individual physiology. This survey reviews PPG-based cuffless BP estimation along the full measurement chain, covering physiological mechanisms, waveform features, pulse arrival time (PAT), pulse transit time (PTT), machine-learning methods, datasets, calibration, validation, deployment, bias, and clinical translation. translated_title: 基于光电容积脉搏波（PPG）的连续无袖带血压估计：从方法到临床转化
translated_abstract: 连续血压（BP）监测能够捕捉间歇性袖带测量所遗漏的血压变化，从而改善高血压管理。光电容积脉搏波（PPG）被广泛探索用于无袖带血压估计，因为光学传感器价格低廉、可穿戴，并且已经广泛应用于许多消费级和临床设备中。然而，PPG并不能直接测量动脉压力：血压是从波形特征或脉搏时间推断出来的，而这些特征同时也受到血管张力、动脉僵硬度、传感器接触情况、运动以及个体生理差异的影响。本综述沿着完整的测量链回顾了基于PPG的无袖带血压估计研究，涵盖生理机制、波形特征、脉搏到达时间（PAT）、脉搏传导时间（PTT）、机器学习方法、数据集、校准、验证、部署、偏差以及临床转化。研究评估依据的是其所提供的证据强度，而不仅仅是报告的误差……
tldr: 本综述系统回顾了基于PPG的无袖带血压估计的完整技术链条，从生理机制、波形特征、PAT/PTT、机器学习到临床转化，并强调应以证据强度而非仅以报告误差来评估研究。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews PPG-based cuffless blood pressure estimation across the full measurement chain—from physiological mechanisms and waveform features to PAT/PTT, machine learning, and clinical translation—assessing studies by strength of evidence rather than reported error alone.
